title: Concept: Cache-Control lacks the no-store directive
description: A response without no-store can be stored by a cache. Stored copies of sensitive pages can be read by later users of that cache. The remedy is Cache-Control: no-store, max-age=0.
applicability: HTTP responses; the header matters most on authenticated or personal pages.
risk: Sensitive page copies kept in shared or browser caches; LOW severity.
